task_title: Vendored systemd unit matches the root-caused host cap (-solve-mem-mb 12288) so check-deploy leg 5 can pass
task_criteria: deploy/off-by-one.service ExecStart carries -solve-mem-mb 12288 and its comment records that 6144 was reverted because Node 22 aborts at lazyllhttp/undici and pi-agent reported 'Connection error.' on every solve after pi 1.5.0. FAILIF: grep of deploy/off-by-one.service still shows '-solve-mem-mb 6144' in the ExecStart line, or the rationale text is absent. PROOF: git grep -n 'solve-mem-mb' deploy/off-by-one.service at HEAD.

scripts/check-deploy --check-flags exits 0 printing PASS for the flags the live unit actually runs, and exits non-zero naming the drift when the same argv carries 6144. FAILIF: PASS arm non-zero, or negative arm exits 0. PROOF: run both argv variants of ./scripts/check-deploy --check-flags deploy/off-by-one.service and quote rc + output.

scripts/check-deploy-test.sh's two drift arms assert the new contract value and the suite is green: bash -n rc=0 and make check-deploy-test ends 'all assertions passed'. FAILIF: 'expected 6144' remains in the script or the suite reports a failure. PROOF: bash -n scripts/check-deploy-test.sh; make check-deploy-test.

items.criterion: deploy/off-by-one.service ExecStart carries -solve-mem-mb 12288 and its comment records that 6144 was reverted because Node 22 aborts at lazyllhttp/undici and pi-agent reported 'Connection error.' on every solve after pi 1.5.0. FAILIF: grep of deploy/off-by-one.service still shows '-solve-mem-mb 6144' in the ExecStart line, or the rationale text is absent. PROOF: git grep -n 'solve-mem-mb' deploy/off-by-one.service at HEAD.
items.detail: git grep -n 'solve-mem-mb' deploy/off-by-one.service -> line 69 ExecStart=... -solve-mem-mb 12288 (no 6144 in the ExecStart line); line 55 comment '-solve-mem-mb 12288 (was 6144; DF-OFF-BY-ONE-30)' and lines 57-60 record '6144 is BELOW what Node 22 needs to initialise undici's fetch path — node aborts at lazyllhttp and pi-agent surfaces the failure as "Connection error." (every solve after the pi 1.5.0 install failed this way, 2026-11-04)'. Rationale present, old value gone from ExecStart.

items.criterion: scripts/check-deploy --check-flags exits 0 printing PASS for the flags the live unit actually runs, and exits non-zero naming the drift when the same argv carries 6144. FAILIF: PASS arm non-zero, or negative arm exits 0. PROOF: run both argv variants of ./scripts/check-deploy --check-flags deploy/off-by-one.service and quote rc + output.
items.detail: PASS arm: ./scripts/check-deploy --check-flags deploy/off-by-one.service "/home/kara/off-by-one/off-by-one --port 8766 -load-threshold 4 -cron-interval 60s -pi-agent /home/kara/.local/bin/pi-agent -bwrap /usr/bin/bwrap -solve-mem-mb 12288" -> 'PASS: running unit's ExecStart flags match deploy/off-by-one.service' rc=0. Negative arm: same argv with -solve-mem-mb 6144 -> 'FAIL: running unit's ExecStart flags drifted from deploy/off-by-one.service:' / '  -solve-mem-mb: expected 12288, observed 6144' rc=1. Contract comparison is exact token equality in scripts/check-deploy check_flag_contract (want != have -> report_flag_drift + return 1).

items.criterion: scripts/check-deploy-test.sh's two drift arms assert the new contract value and the suite is green: bash -n rc=0 and make check-deploy-test ends 'all assertions passed'. FAILIF: 'expected 6144' remains in the script or the suite reports a failure. PROOF: bash -n scripts/check-deploy-test.sh; make check-deploy-test.
items.detail: bash -n scripts/check-deploy-test.sh -> rc=0; grep -n 'expected 6144' scripts/check-deploy-test.sh -> no match (rc=1); both drift arms now assert 'solve-mem-mb: expected 12288, observed <absent>' (scripts/check-deploy-test.sh:278 and :594). make check-deploy-test -> exit_code 0, 27 '^PASS' lines, 0 '^FAIL' lines, final line 'check-deploy-test: all assertions passed'. [resolution 0.00; scripts/check-deploy-test.sh]

items.criterion: The 12288 value is a real daemon flag and the leg-5 contract comparison is token-exact, so the vendored unit's ExecStart is genuinely what leg 5 compares against the live unit (no normalization that would mask 6144 vs 12288).
items.detail: cmd/off-by-one/main.go:422 registers fs.Int("solve-mem-mb", envInt("OFF_BY_ONE_SOLVE_MEM_MB", 0), ...), so the flag exists and 12288 is a valid value. scripts/check-deploy normalize_flags only strips one layer of quotes/whitespace; check_flag_contract fails on any token difference, proven by the live negative run printing '-solve-mem-mb: expected 12288, observed 6144' rc=1.

items.criterion: The change does not leave the repo's own docs/tests asserting the old 6144 cap as the deploy contract (stale 'the deploy unit's -solve-mem-mb 6144' text).
items.detail: Stale 6144-as-contract text survives in docs the deploy story itself points at: docs/dogfood/diagnostics.md:1051 'ExecStart=... --port 8766 -load-threshold 4 ... -solve-mem-mb 6144      # the vendored canonical unit' and :1063 '  -solve-mem-mb: expected 6144, observed <absent>' (the documented leg-5 failure text), and skills/off-by-one-usage/SKILL.md:532 'The vendored deploy/off-by-one.service ships `-load-threshold 4 … -solve-mem-mb 6144`'. The commit updated docs/api-reference.md:807 (12288 -> ~9.6 GiB) but not these, so a reader following diagnostics.md would re-introduce the drift. Go test comments also still call 6144 'the deploy unit's value' (internal/cron/memgate_test.go:481, cmd/off-by-one/main_test.go:424) — those tests pass (go test ./internal/cron/ ./cmd/off-by-one/ -run 'TestSolveRejectThreshold|TestResolveSolveRejectBytes' -count=1 -> ok ok) but the comments are now wrong.

items.criterion: The two drift arms still bite: they are not tautological against the unit file they read, i.e. reverting the contract to 6144 would make them fail.
items.detail: scripts/check-deploy-test.sh:240 derives contract_exec from deploy/off-by-one.service and the arms grep the failure text emitted by check-deploy's report_flag_drift ('solve-mem-mb: expected 12288, observed <absent>'), which is generated from the contract file's own value; the negative --check-flags run with 6144 exits 1 naming the drift, and make check-deploy-test reports 27 PASS / 0 FAIL, so the arms are live assertions on the contract value.
